verification: MAX over player_id of SUM(b.runs) across filtered summaries >= 250 (same player must accumulate). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Fifty Pair
description: Record 2 innings of 50 or more runs across the week.
verification: COUNT(batting innings b with b.runs >= 50) >= 2 (centuries count). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Fifty Brigade
description: Have 3 different batters each score 50 or more at least once this week.
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT b.player_id with b.runs >= 50 in any filtered summary) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Not Out Nerve
description: Finish not out on 50 or more runs in 2 different innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 50 AND b.dismissed == false) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Fast Fifties
description: Score 50 or more off 35 balls or fewer in 2 different innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 50 AND 0 < b.35 <= 35) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Batting Pillar
description: Have one batter accumulate 700 runs across the week.
verification: MAX over player_id of SUM(b.runs) across filtered summaries >= 700 (same player must accumulate). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Century Pair
description: Record 2 innings of 100 or more runs across the week.
verification: COUNT(batting innings b with b.runs >= 100) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Rapid Century
description: Score 100 or more off 65 balls or fewer in a single innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 100 AND 0 < b.65 <= 65) >= 1. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Boundary Week
description: Hit 60 boundaries (fours and sixes combined) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(b.fours + b.sixes) over filtered summaries >= 60. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Six Sweep

verification: SUM(b.sixes) over filtered summaries >= 25. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Over Of Fire

verification: COUNT(complete overs (balls==6) where batting_team_id == user_id AND runs >= 20) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Boundary Overlord
description: Have one batter hit 14 boundaries (fours and sixes combined) in a single match.
verification: MAX(b.fours + b.sixes) in a single filtered summary >= 14. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Wicket Week
description: Take 25 wickets across completed matches.
verification: SUM(MS.bowling_wickets) over filtered summaries >= 25. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Brace Collector

verification: COUNT(bowling spells with bw.wickets >= 2) >= 4. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Three-Fer Trio

verification: COUNT(bowling spells with bw.wickets >= 3) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Bowling Spearhead

verification: MAX over bowler player_id of SUM(bw.wickets) across filtered summaries >= 12. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Maiden Maker

verification: COUNT(over_history rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND balls == 6 AND runs == 0) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Wicket Empire

verification: SUM(MS.bowling_wickets) over filtered summaries >= 65. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: SUM(over.wickets) over rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND over.powerplay == powerplay >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Middle Squeeze

verification: SUM(over.wickets) over rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND over.middle == middle >= 15. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Death Wickets
description: Take 12 wickets in the death overs (16-20) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.wickets) over rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND over.death == death >= 12. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

description: Take 15 wickets in the powerplay (overs 1-6) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.wickets) over rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND over.powerplay == powerplay >= 15. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: COUNT(complete overs (balls==6) in death where bowling_team_id == user_id AND runs <= 4) >= 4. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase Habit
description: Win 3 matches while chasing.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 3. Filters: chasing=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Defence Habit
description: Win 3 matches while defending a total (batting first).
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 3. Filters: defending=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase Builder
description: Have one batter accumulate 150 runs while chasing across the week.
verification: MAX over player_id of SUM(b.runs) across filtered summaries >= 150 (same player must accumulate). Filters: chasing=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase 160
description: Win 2 chases of a target of 160 or more.
verification: COUNT(summaries with chasing AND won AND MS.2 >= 2_min) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Late Charges
description: Win 2 chases that last 15 overs or longer.
verification: COUNT(summaries with chasing AND won AND late_chase) >= 2 (2nd-innings legal_balls >= 90, i.e. the chase lasted 15 or more overs). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Cool Heads
description: Win 2 chases after losing 4 wickets or fewer.

description: Record 3 innings of 50 or more in matches you win while chasing.

title: Defence 170
description: Win 2 matches while defending a total of 170 or more.
verification: COUNT(summaries with defending AND won AND MS.batting_runs >= 170) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Defence Master

verification: COUNT(filtered summaries) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: SUM(MS.batting_runs) over filtered summaries >= 600 (and COUNT(summaries) >= min_matches if given). Filters: match_type=PLAYIPL. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: For each of PLAY, PLAYIPL, PLAYINT: COUNT(won summaries) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: SUM(MS.bowling_wickets) over filtered summaries >= 8. Filters: pitch='green'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Flat Week

verification: SUM(MS.batting_runs) over filtered summaries >= 300 (and COUNT(summaries) >= min_matches if given). Filters: pitch='flat'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: SUM(MS.batting_runs) over filtered summaries >= 300 (and COUNT(summaries) >= min_matches if given). Filters: pitch='dry'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

description: Win 4 matches on DRY pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 4. Filters: pitch='dry'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 3. Filters: pitch='bouncy', defending=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: COUNT(summaries where some player_id has batting 25 >= 25 AND bowling wickets >= 2 in the same summary) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: COUNT(summaries where some player_id has batting 40 >= 40 AND bowling wickets >= 2 in the same summary) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.ovr >= 65) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.ovr >= 80) >= 1. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Fifty Brigade Elite
description: Have 6 different batters each score 50 or more at least once this month.
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT b.player_id with b.runs >= 50 in any filtered summary) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Century Collector
description: Record 3 innings of 100 or more runs across the month.
verification: COUNT(batting innings b with b.runs >= 100) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Calm Finisher
description: Finish not out on 50 or more runs in 6 different innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 50 AND b.dismissed == false) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Rapid Fifties
description: Score 50 or more off 35 balls or fewer in 6 different innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 50 AND 0 < b.35 <= 35) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Run Legend
description: Have one batter accumulate 3,500 runs across the month.
verification: MAX over player_id of SUM(b.runs) across filtered summaries >= 3500 (same player must accumulate). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Strike Rate Elite
description: Score 40 or more at a strike rate of 160 or higher in 8 different innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 40 AND b.balls > 0 AND b.runs*100/b.balls >= 160) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Blitz Centuries
description: Score 100 or more off 65 balls or fewer in 3 different innings.
verification: COUNT(batting innings with b.runs >= 100 AND 0 < b.65 <= 65) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Boundary Month
description: Hit 250 boundaries (fours and sixes combined) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(b.fours + b.sixes) over filtered summaries >= 250. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Six Season
description: Hit 100 sixes across completed matches.
verification: SUM(b.sixes) over filtered summaries >= 100. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Power Hitter
description: Have one batter hit 40 sixes across the month.
verification: MAX over player_id of SUM(b.sixes) across filtered summaries >= 40. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Fire Overs
description: Score 20 or more runs in a single over on 10 different occasions.
verification: COUNT(complete overs (balls==6) where batting_team_id == user_id AND runs >= 20) >= 10. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Boundary Colossus
description: Have one batter hit 18 boundaries (fours and sixes combined) in a single match.
verification: MAX(b.fours + b.sixes) in a single filtered summary >= 18. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Wicket Month
description: Take 100 wickets across completed matches this month.
verification: SUM(MS.bowling_wickets) over filtered summaries >= 100. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Spell Collector
description: Record 15 bowling spells of 2 or more wickets.
verification: COUNT(bowling spells with bw.wickets >= 2) >= 15. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Three-Wicket Club
description: Record 8 bowling spells of 3 or more wickets.
verification: COUNT(bowling spells with bw.wickets >= 3) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Strike Bowler
description: Have one bowler take 50 wickets across the month.
verification: MAX over bowler player_id of SUM(bw.wickets) across filtered summaries >= 50. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Maiden Club
description: Bowl 8 maiden overs across completed matches.
verification: COUNT(over_history rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND balls == 6 AND runs == 0) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Bowl-Out Specialists
description: Bowl the opposition out (take 10 wickets) in 6 different matches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.bowling_wickets >= 10) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Wicket Titan
description: Take 350 wickets across completed matches this month.
verification: SUM(MS.bowling_wickets) over filtered summaries >= 350. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Four-For Club
description: Record 5 bowling spells of 4 or more wickets.
verification: COUNT(bowling spells with bw.wickets >= 4) >= 5. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Five-For Pair
description: Record 2 bowling spells of 5 wickets.
verification: COUNT(bowling spells with bw.wickets >= 5) >= 2. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Elite Spells
description: Bowl 5 full 4-over spells at an economy of 5.5 or lower.
verification: COUNT(spells with bw.balls >= 24 AND bw.runs*6/bw.balls <= 5.5 AND bw.wickets >= w (w default 0)) >= 5. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Dot Fortress
description: Bowl 1,100 dot balls across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.dots) over over_history rows where over.bowling_team_id == user_id (phase filter if given) >= 1100. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Powerplay Season
description: Score 900 runs in the powerplay (overs 1-6) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.runs) over rows where batting_team_id == user_id AND over.powerplay == powerplay >= 900. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Death Overs Season
description: Score 800 runs in the death overs (16-20) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.runs) over rows where batting_team_id == user_id AND over.death == death >= 800. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Powerplay Hunters
description: Take 40 wickets in the powerplay (overs 1-6) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.wickets) over rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND over.powerplay == powerplay >= 40. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Middle Strangle
description: Take 70 wickets in the middle overs (7-15) across completed matches.
verification: SUM(over.wickets) over rows where bowling_team_id == user_id AND over.middle == middle >= 70. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Death Lockdown
description: Bowl 15 complete death overs (overs 16-20) conceding 5 runs or fewer each.
verification: COUNT(complete overs (balls==6) in death where bowling_team_id == user_id AND runs <= 5) >= 15. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Powerplay Blasts
description: Score 70 or more runs in the powerplay (overs 1-6) of 6 different innings.
verification: COUNT(innings where SUM(over.runs in powerplay, batting rows) >= powerplay_min) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase Season
description: Win 8 matches while chasing.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: chasing=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Defence Season
description: Win 8 matches while defending a total (batting first).
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: defending=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Late Chase Legends
description: Win 6 chases that last 15 overs or longer.
verification: COUNT(summaries with chasing AND won AND late_chase) >= 6 (2nd-innings legal_balls >= 90, i.e. the chase lasted 15 or more overs). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase Fifties Season
description: Record 8 innings of 50 or more in matches you win while chasing.
verification: COUNT(batting innings b with b.runs >= 50) >= 8 (centuries count). Filters: chasing=true, won=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Total 180 Defence
description: Win 4 matches while defending a total of 180 or more.
verification: COUNT(summaries with defending AND won AND MS.batting_runs >= 180) >= 4. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Balanced Season
description: Win at least 8 matches while chasing and 8 matches while defending in the same month.
verification: COUNT(chasing wins) >= 8 AND COUNT(defending wins) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase Emperor
description: Win at least 65% of your chases, from a minimum of 15 matches played while chasing.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries) >= 15 AND wins*100/COUNT >= 65 (percent). Filters: chasing=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase 190 Club
description: Win 4 chases of a target of 190 or more.
verification: COUNT(summaries with chasing AND won AND MS.4 >= 4_min) >= 4. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Cool Hand Chasers
description: Win 10 chases after losing 3 wickets or fewer.
verification: COUNT(summaries with chasing AND won AND COUNT(b.dismissed) <= 3) >= 10. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Lockdown Wins
description: Win 6 matches in which your bowlers concede 115 runs or fewer.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with won AND SUM(bw.runs) <= 115) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Chase Centurions
description: Record 3 innings of 100 or more runs while chasing.
verification: COUNT(batting innings b with b.runs >= 100) >= 3. Filters: chasing=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Monthly Wins
description: Win 12 completed matches this month.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 12. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Active Player
description: Complete 30 matches this month.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries) >= 30. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Pitch Tour
description: Complete matches on 6 different pitch types.
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT MS.pitch among filtered summaries) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Streak Season
description: Win 6 matches in a row.
verification: Longest run of consecutive MS.won == true, ordered by played_at over filtered summaries, >= 6 (a loss or tie breaks the run). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Hard Yards
description: Win 8 matches on HARD pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: pitch='hard'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Winning Dynasty
description: Win 45 completed matches this month.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 45. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Unstoppable
description: Win 10 matches in a row.
verification: Longest run of consecutive MS.won == true, ordered by played_at over filtered summaries, >= 10 (a loss or tie breaks the run). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Elite Win Rate
description: Win at least 70% of your matches, from a minimum of 35 completed matches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries) >= 35 AND wins*100/COUNT >= 70 (percent). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Grand Slam Pitches
description: Win matches on all 8 pitch types (GREEN, DRY, DUSTY, FLAT, HARD, EVEN, BOUNCY, SLOW).
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT MS.pitch among won summaries) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: League Regular
description: Complete 10 Play IPL matches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries) >= 10. Filters: match_type=PLAYIPL. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: IPL Champion
description: Win 12 Play IPL matches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 12. Filters: match_type=PLAYIPL. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: League Season
description: Score 2,500 team runs across Play IPL matches.
verification: SUM(MS.batting_runs) over filtered summaries >= 2500 (and COUNT(summaries) >= min_matches if given). Filters: match_type=PLAYIPL. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Triple Crown
description: Win at least 8 matches in each of the 3 game modes (Play, Play IPL, Play International).
verification: For each of PLAY, PLAYIPL, PLAYINT: COUNT(won summaries) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Green Season
description: Win 4 matches on GREEN pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 4. Filters: pitch='green'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Flat Season
description: Score 1,000 team runs on FLAT pitches.
verification: SUM(MS.batting_runs) over filtered summaries >= 1000 (and COUNT(summaries) >= min_matches if given). Filters: pitch='flat'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Dry Season
description: Win 8 matches on DRY pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: pitch='dry'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Dusty Season
description: Take 40 wickets on DUSTY pitches.
verification: SUM(MS.bowling_wickets) over filtered summaries >= 40. Filters: pitch='dusty'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Even Season
description: Win 8 matches on EVEN pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: pitch='even'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Bouncy Season
description: Hit 40 sixes on BOUNCY pitches.
verification: SUM(b.sixes) over filtered summaries >= 40. Filters: pitch='bouncy'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Slow Season
description: Have one batter accumulate 600 runs on SLOW pitches.
verification: MAX over player_id of SUM(b.runs) across filtered summaries >= 600 (same player must accumulate). Filters: pitch='slow'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Green Seam Dynasty
description: Have one bowler take 25 wickets on GREEN pitches.
verification: MAX over bowler player_id of SUM(bw.wickets) across filtered summaries >= 25. Filters: pitch='green'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Dust Chase Kings
description: Win 8 matches while chasing on DUSTY pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: pitch='dusty', chasing=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Bounce Bastions
description: Win 8 matches while defending a total on BOUNCY pitches.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with MS.won == true) >= 8. Filters: pitch='bouncy', defending=true. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Slow Lockdown Season
description: Win 5 matches on SLOW pitches in which your bowlers concede 120 runs or fewer.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries with won AND SUM(bw.runs) <= 120) >= 5. Filters: pitch='slow'. Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: All-Rounder Season
description: Have a player score 25 or more runs and take 2 or more wickets in the same match, 6 times this month.
verification: COUNT(summaries where some player_id has batting 25 >= 25 AND bowling wickets >= 2 in the same summary) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Complete Wins Season
description: Win 10 matches in which one batter scores 50 or more and one bowler takes 3 or more wickets.
verification: COUNT(won summaries with a batter >= 50 runs AND a bowler >= 3 wickets) >= 10. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Twin Fifty Season
description: In 8 different matches, have 2 batters each score 50 or more.
verification: COUNT(filtered summaries where COUNT(b with b.runs >= 50) >= 2) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Elite All-Rounders
description: Have a player score 40 or more runs and take 3 or more wickets in the same match, 5 times this month.
verification: COUNT(summaries where some player_id has batting 40 >= 40 AND bowling wickets >= 3 in the same summary) >= 5. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Roster Builder
description: Purchase 10 players of 65 OVR or higher.
verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.ovr >= 65) >= 10. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Quality Signings
description: Purchase 8 players of 70 OVR or higher.
verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.ovr >= 70) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Rare Roster
description: Purchase 3 players of 75 OVR or higher.
verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.ovr >= 75) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Epic Signing
description: Purchase 1 player of 85 OVR or higher.
verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.ovr >= 85) >= 1. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Shop Regular
description: Spend 150,000 Coins in the Player Shop.
verification: SUM(value_int of COIN_SPENT events with metadata.source == 'player_shop') >= 150000 (exit penalties excluded). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Special Signings
description: Purchase 3 special players.
verification: COUNT(PLAYER_PURCHASE events with metadata.is_special == true) >= 3. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Coin Tycoon
description: Spend 2,000,000 Coins in the Player Shop.
verification: SUM(value_int of COIN_SPENT events with metadata.source == 'player_shop') >= 2000000 (exit penalties excluded). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Gear Collector
description: Equip 8 upgrades on your players.
verification: COUNT(UPGRADE_APPLIED events) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Upgrade Variety
description: Equip 6 different upgrade types.
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT metadata.upgrade_key among UPGRADE_APPLIED events) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Tier Masters
description: Level up owned upgrades 6 times.
verification: COUNT(RUBY_SPENT events with metadata.source == 'upgrade_levelup') >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Ruby Budget
description: Spend 5,000 Rubies on upgrades (purchases and level-ups).
verification: SUM(value_int of RUBY_SPENT events with metadata.source IN ('upgrade_purchase','upgrade_levelup')) >= 5000 (coin_exchange excluded). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Fully Geared
description: Equip upgrades on 9 different players.
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT metadata.player_id among UPGRADE_APPLIED events) >= 9. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Claim Month
description: Successfully claim 30 players.
verification: COUNT(CLAIM_SUCCESS events) >= 30. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Claim Rhythm
description: Successfully claim a player on 15 different days.
verification: COUNT(DISTINCT metadata.event_date among CLAIM_SUCCESS events) >= 15. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Reward Streak
description: Collect your daily reward on 14 consecutive days.
verification: Longest run of consecutive calendar dates (metadata.event_date) with a DAILY_REWARD_CLAIM event >= 14. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Pack Pipeline
description: Open 8 packs.
verification: COUNT(PACK_OPENED events (metadata.pack_key == pack_key if given)) >= 8. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Platinum Pull
description: Open a Platinum Pack.
verification: COUNT(PACK_OPENED events (metadata.pack_key == pack_key if given)) >= 1. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: League Compliance Season
description: Confirm a Playing XI that contains exactly 4 overseas players, 6 times.
verification: COUNT(OVERSEAS_XI_CONFIRMED events with metadata.4 == 4) >= 6. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Quest Starter
description: Complete 20 Daily Quests this month.
verification: COUNT(quest_completions rows, period_type=daily, completed in the current period) >= 20 (the task itself is excluded). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Streak Starter
description: Complete at least one Daily Quest on 5 consecutive days.
verification: Longest run of consecutive dates with >= 1 daily quest completion >= 5. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Weekly Sweep
description: Complete 12 Weekly Quests this month.
verification: COUNT(quest_completions rows, period_type=weekly, in the current month) >= 12 (the task itself is excluded). Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Quest Perfectionist
description: Complete all 5 assigned Daily Quests on 15 different days.
verification: COUNT(dates on which all 5 assigned daily quests were completed) >= 15. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.

title: Streak Keeper
description: Complete at least one Daily Quest on 21 consecutive days.
verification: Longest run of consecutive dates with >= 1 daily quest completion >= 21. Filters: none (all PLAY/PLAYIPL/PLAYINT summaries in the period). Evaluate once per period from stored rows only.
